notes: Title verified for both retrieved papers. Replication source is the OSF preprint linked by the supplied ue9gm file locator (Tam and Feldman, posted 2024, describing 2021 work); supplied AHCPW DOI identifies preregistration. Original source is a full-paper HTML transcription retrieved via web tooling after direct publisher/SSRN access failed; its cache preserves the web parse. Critical locator discrepancy: Table 15 concerns the extension emotion outcome, so replication target_match is false. Values above faithfully retain that supplied table rather than silently combining it with the work-hours test. The actual work-hours replication is reported separately on p. 43 and Table 11: F(1,1037) = 12.48, p <.001, η2 = 0.01[0.003, 0.03]. Authors' successful verdict concerns that Study 2 replication, not an independent replication of the extension emotion outcome. Original locator p.3 is interpreted as PDF page 3 (journal p.25). No metric conversions performed.
